question: Which selected native command boundaries distinguish army disbanding from unit deletion, and do they identify the reported loaded-fleet Gold credit?

scope.boundary: Selected mapper words, two dispatcher cases, the disband helper and three exact same-low-immediate discrimination windows. Candidate-window owners were not established; six is a conservative upper charge, not six complete function bodies. Unused neighboring words provide no semantics. No whole cargo traversal, refund/value producer, UI input route or completed helper-call contract is included.

dependencies.use: Command-type-to-debug-label mapper input and bounded table identity.
Accepted numeric dispatcher targets and separate command delivery/authority limits.
Accepted0x82D02390 mode0 unit-removal semantics, including carried units; removal is not a refund contract.
Accepted player Gold reserve0x830ED544+4*p without a sole-writer claim.
Closed modeled-reference negative does not exclude split-address native accesses.
Owns the separate selected sale producer, linked-factor collection, carrier multiplier and Gold-command credit.

selectedCommands.armyDisband: Mapper type11 cell0x82CD544C selects0x82CD55B8, which returns the DisbandA label at0x82156C48. Its accepted dispatcher target0x82CE02A0 calls0x82D13520(r31,r15), then clears a selected unit flag and completes through0x82CE16AC.
selectedCommands.helper: 0x82D13550 clears addressed unit byte+4. The helper runs two iterations, conditionally calling creator0x82D11750 for a non-minus-one type, then copies selected rank/movement/status fields and invokes root virtual+0x1B8. Creator return-1 handling, callback effects/retention and actual resulting units remain unbound. These inspected words identify a creation/copy operation, not the reported sale payout.
selectedCommands.unitDeletion: Mapper type16 cell0x82CD5460 selects0x82CD55F4, which returns DelUnit at0x82156C78. Its accepted dispatcher target0x82CE1354 passes r3=r31,r4=r15,r5=0 to0x82D02390 at0x82CE1360, then completes through0x82CE16AC. This joins the selected command to accepted unit removal, not to an explicit player-reserve credit.
selectedCommands.qualification: Neither command label establishes the human sale input, the carrier/passenger valuation or a Gold transaction. This command/hint read set supplies no proved fleet/cargo multiplier. The disband helper's unresolved virtual effects prevent a whole-call-tree no-credit claim.

saleHintLead.identity: Defined UI sale-hint text is at0x82125A14. Its decoded materializer search emitted zero matches and its aligned full-pointer search emitted zero; both read sets are closed bounded negatives.
saleHintLead.rawDiscriminator: A raw addi-immediate0x5A14 inventory with mask0xFC00FFFF emitted three candidates.0x8260A308 and0x8260A52C use high0x8208, so they are not the selected hint.0x82E58E2C/34 instead forms0x82125A14 in r4 and calls0x82E6A430 at0x82E58E38, then transfers the returned value toward0x82E59424. The callee and actual UI action remain unexpanded.
saleHintLead.coverage: At0x82E58E34 the canonical function-neighborhood query reports no containing function and no instructions in its selected window. Raw native words support the local materializer; the incomplete listing supplies no input-dispatch, helper or complete-body claim.
saleHintLead.remaining: Join the actual hint/UI receiver to the selected producer in unit-sale-refund-value-boundary, retaining current unit/player identity. The hint's presence alone does not establish that action or refund.

closedReserveSearch.result: The query reached its8-match display cap. The displayed candidates were not expanded or assigned reserve semantics. This form is closed as capped output and cannot prove an exhaustive writer inventory or absence of another source.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra queries and exact big-endian PowerPC decoding, checked against the supported flat image; no generated function body or runtime was read.

guards: Do not treat DisbandA or UnitKill as a proved sale/refund producer.
Do not divide every refund by3 or infer passenger value from the carrier's army/fleet flag.
Keep American rush discounts, cargo army state, carrier fleet state and actual reserve changes distinct.
Static command/hint identity does not reproduce the reported single-passenger or ten-passenger payout.
falsification: Different command table/case/helper words falsify the selected boundaries. A sale-input-to-credit join with retained cargo identities can establish or reject the reported multiplier and selects the next valuation investigation.
conclusion: The selected army-disband command performs conditional unit creation/copy work; the separate unit-delete command reaches native removal. A raw sale-hint materializer is identified despite the incomplete canonical listing. The separate unit-sale-refund-value-boundary owns the cargo valuation and credit join; hint/input delivery and an implemented resale correction remain unverified.
